name: Division by Zero: Tool Failure Handling
description: Learn to catch a real tool exception, report structured failure to the model, prevent a repeated failed call, and stop on the final response.
learning_objectives: Catch exceptions at the tool-execution boundary without crashing solve().
Create failure evidence from the actual exception.
Return structured failure through the matching function call ID.
Keep model-turn and tool-attempt limits separate.
Reject retries after the configured tool-attempt limit.
Stop only on a valid final model message.

messages.content: Use the division tool to divide 100 by 0. If the tool fails, do not retry it or call another tool. Explain the failure in a final message after receiving the tool error.

tools.name: divide_numbers
tools.description: Divide a dividend by a divisor.
